spec.description: Rigidly clamped x=0 gearbox interface. Take z as vertical and y as depth. At x=160, 16x16 mm lug patches centered at (y,z)=(40,72) and (40,8) carry equal opposing y forces, giving +40 N*m about x and zero resultant force. Preserve each lug as a 2 mm deep solid pad within the envelope.
